history.title: Journey to History
history.description: Salihli is home to a rich historical heritage stretching from ancient times to the present day. Sardis, the capital of the Lydian Kingdom where money was invented, is the most precious treasure of these lands. As an important metropolis during the Roman Empire, the city hosted one of the first seven churches of Christianity. During the Byzantine period, it maintained its importance as a strategic episcopal center. This journey invites you to trace the footsteps of thousands of years of civilizations.
